subject: We received your Marketplace application
html:
Application received

Hi Ngozi Eze, thanks for submitting your profile. Our team reviews every expert before they appear on the Marketplace. We'll email you when there's a decision or if we need anything more.

Open your expert portal

Or paste this link into your browser:
